about.title: Tungkul
about.intro: {project} metung yang plataporma na ning tutuking henerasyon para king peer-to-peer a pamipalibutad da reng file, gewa king moderno at disentralisadu a teknolohiya. Pisasama na ing malagwa pamigamit a interface na ning tau king metung a kumpletung disentralisadu a arkitektura, mibibie ya na ing seguro at masasarigan a pamipalibutad da reng datu alang kakailangan ka sentral a awtoridad. Ing proyektung iti open source, mibibili ya lalam ning {license}.

decentralized.title: Kumpletung disentralisadu a network
decentralized.description: Alang sentral a server, alang metung mu a punto da ning pamangapakyas. Reng tau makakit la at maka-download la ning sulud direktang ibat king metung at metung, alang depende king metung a sentral a indexer, tracker o database.

accessControl.title: Pinung kontrol na ning pamanglub
accessControl.description: Ninu mang tau, malyari yang gawang libre ing kayang sariling network agpang king kayang sariling reng panuntunan. King kilub ning balang network, midefinihan la reng papel da reng tau: ing may-ari, administrador, talapamigatlu, moderador at talag-download. Magkaroon ka pinung kontrol king ninu ing malyaring magpalaganap, mag-moderate at mag-download ning sulud.

ui.title: Mataas a kalidad a interface na ning tau
ui.description: Malinis at maglubug a interface na ning media center, gewa para reng plataporma da reng desktop, TV at mobile. Malagwang nabigasyon king pamamilatan ning keyboard, mouse, gamepad o remote control. Reng abante a tau, malyari dang patalbugan ing programa bilang headless a file server king pamamilatan ning command line interface.

dataFormat.title: Pormat na ning datu a mababasa da reng tau
dataFormat.description: Ing pormat na ning datu LISH gewa king JSON, ne ginawa kang malagwang gawan, basan at intindihan. Ipalaganap mu ing kekang sulud kayabe da reng malino at transparenteng metadata a malyaring siyasat-siyasatan ning ninu mang tau.

security.title: Pribasidad at seguridad
security.description: Eganagana reng peer-to-peer a komunikasyon makakencrypt la, mititiyak na manatili lang pribadu reng kekang datu durante na ning paghatud. Reng tau, malyari dang isuksok la king likod na ning VPN para king dagdag a pamangalang ngaran. Reriespetuan na ning {project} ing kekang pribasidad king pamamilatan na ning disenyo.

crossPlatform.title: Cross-platform
crossPlatform.description: Ing programa makakuwa ya king Windows, Linux at macOS. Gamitan me ing nanu mang aparato a atin ka.

download.title: I-download
download.description: Kuwa me ing {project} para king kekang plataporma. Eganagana reng download libre la at open source.
